problem_restatement.observed: V58 lacks a frequent BTC-long route, while several obvious continuation, transfer, and trigger-relaxation candidates have already failed.
problem_restatement.tested: One preregistered BTC hourly EMA21/55 uptrend breakout above the previous twenty hourly highs, admitted only when the latest strictly prior settled Hyperliquid funding rate was negative.
problem_restatement.control: The identical hourly breakout, onset, 60/60/24h exit, sizing, fee, funding-cashflow, and slippage contract without the negative-funding entry predicate.

mechanism_control_comparison.interpretation: The funding predicate avoided many losing ordinary breakouts in development and pseudo-holdout but failed its incremental-value requirement in validation. More importantly, the filtered candidate itself remained negative before costs and after costs in both forward partitions.

accepted: The exact candidate is economically falsified under the preregistered validation, pseudo-holdout, stress, delay, largest-winner, cadence, and control requirements.
Costs alone do not explain the rejection because gross market PnL was negative in validation and pseudo-holdout.
Negative settled funding did not identify a stable profitable subset of hourly BTC breakouts.
The candidate is too sparse in pseudo-holdout for the requested practical opportunity objective.
not_established: that all funding-conditioned BTC strategies lack edge
that cross-venue basis or spot-versus-perpetual flow would behave like Hyperliquid settled funding
that no materially different BTC long mechanism can pass future preregistered tests
failure_modes: Negative funding can represent informed bearish pressure rather than merely uncrowded positioning.
Settled funding may be too stale or coarse for an hourly breakout entry.
Hyperliquid-only funding cannot distinguish spot-led demand from cross-venue derivatives demand.
The fixed 60/60 exit may be mismatched to trend continuation, but changing it after these results would be post-hoc rescue and requires a new independent hypothesis.

decision.next_action: Do not open another nearby BTC breakout or funding threshold variant. Preserve the selective sweep control and require a new data-backed mechanism with information absent from the current price-plus-settled-funding inputs before another BTC-long preregistration.

falsifiers: A source, causality, partition, funding-availability, signal, exit, or accounting defect changes the reproduced trade identities or economics.

A prospectively frozen materially distinct mechanism using additional point-in-time information passes validation, pseudo-holdout, cost, delay, concentration, shared-capital, and execution-feasibility tests.
Venue-matched prospective evidence under the unchanged exact rule contradicts the historical rejection across enough independent events without reliance on one winner.
